text:
maria (AE): Quick sync — ACME wants a 4-week POC. Need to lock success metrics, hosting constraints, and a recommended deployment path. Can we align today? :calendar:

samir (SE): 👍 available. quick Qs: are they okay with test data only, or will we touch PII? Also, what's their target latency/throughput?

maria (AE): Security team said some customer data will remain in their systems; they may want embeddings computed in-region. They flagged <company> security questionnaire (SLA + KMS). Latency target is 99th p95-ish — they said sub-350ms for single-turn generation; throughput ~50 rps expected at peak.

elaine (Solutions Eng): That latency + throughput combo is feasible but hosting choice matters. Quick breakdown: hosted -> fastest setup (2–3 days), limited region lock (we can place in us-east-1 or eu-west-1), no dedicated GPU guarantees. Dedicated -> reserved pool, predictable p99/p95 and commit pricing (2–3 weeks provisioning). Private -> on-prem/VPC, longest (4–8 weeks), meets strict residency & KMS/HSM.

nate (Presales): Pricing Q: customer asked ballpark of monthly for Dedicated vs Hosted for 50 rps with 1k token avg per request. Can we give a range?

elaine (Solutions Eng): Ballpark: Hosted (pay-as-you-go) ~= $X–$Y / mo depending on model and token count. Dedicated (reserved) — depends on commit size but expect unit cost ~30–50% lower than hosted at steady load. I'll hand off exact numbers to finance, but for POC we can approximate to decision-makers.

samir (SE): Security questionnaire — they asked about envelope encryption + customer KMS and audit logs. For Dedicated we support CMK + cloud KMS; Private supports customer-managed HSM. Need to confirm specific SOC/ISO controls they care about.

maria (AE): They're enterprise IT — will push SOC2 and iso27001 checks. Also want IP separation so no model fine-tuning on shared datasets.

elaine (Solutions Eng): For the POC success criteria propose we list measurable items: 
- Latency: p95 <= 350ms for 1k-token requests in target region
- Throughput: sustain 50 RPS for 1 minute without queueing
- Cost/Token: demonstrate steady-state token cost reduction target (if Dedicated) by >=20% vs Hosted baseline
- Quality: eval harness BLEU/ROUGE or task-specific metric >= baseline threshold (we should provide prompt set and scoring)
- Data residency: embeddings computed and stored in the chosen region only

samir (SE): + add reliability: no more than 1% error rate for inference calls during a 24h test window.

nate (Presales): Timeline I suggest: week 0 — kickoff + security questionnaire; week 1 — infra provisioning (hosted quickstart or initiate Dedicated provisioning); week 2 — ingest eval prompts + run initial baseline; week 3 — tuning + run stability load tests; week 4 — final report + ROI estimate. Is that realistic?

elaine (Solutions Eng): Yes. For Dedicated we need to start provisioning in week 0 to have GPUs ready by week 2. For Private, note network/infra access reviews may push the timeline.

maria (AE): Customer asked whether we can run the POC in eu-west-1 due to EU residency. Which hosting modes can we support there immediately?

elaine (Solutions Eng): Hosted: eu-west-1 available. Dedicated: depends on capacity — we have dedicated pools in eu-west-1 but need to check availability for the requested commit. Private: possible if their infra is in EU or via our EU private package, but that'll be slower. I'll ping infra.

samir (SE): Operational config snippet we should hand them for the POC (example):

```
model: gpt-open-7b
region: eu-west-1
deployment_mode: dedicated  # or hosted/private
max_tokens: 1024
concurrency_target: 50
latency_slo_ms: 350
use_kms: true
```

samir (SE): Also flagging eval harness command we plan to run: `./run_eval.sh --suite acme-critical-prompts --warmup 200 --rps 50 --report out.json`

nate (Presales): Security/residency ask: they want proof that embeddings never leave EU. For Hosted we can guarantee region-local inference + storage; need to confirm retention policy and key ownership. Elaine, can you confirm retention defaults and whether we can configure zero-retention for POC?

elaine (Solutions Eng): We can set short retention (7 days) or zero retention for logs/inputs for POC. For Dedicated/Private, data stays in their VPC/tenant. KMS: hosted supports customer-managed keys in supported clouds — need to enable in config.

maria (AE): Great. Action items: 
- elaine: confirm eu-west-1 Dedicated capacity availability and exact cost delta (ETA 24h)
- samir: prepare eval harness and the prompt set + runbook (ETA 48h)
- nate: request copy of their filled security questionnaire and confirm SOC/ISO asks (ETA 24h)
- maria: schedule kickoff call for Monday (invite ACME + infra + security)

ops-bot: noted. Task created: #POC-1834 with assignees elaine, samir, nate, maria. ETA tags applied.

samir (SE): one more note — if we go Dedicated, add fallback policy to hosted to avoid downtime during provisioning. config snippet: `fallback: hosted`

maria (AE): Perfect. I'll send this summary to the customer now and include the proposed success criteria. Thanks everyone :pray:
